Background on the Colt M733

The Colt Model 733 Commando was introduced by Colt during the 1980s and 1990s to meet the demand for a shorter, lighter carbine suited to close-range operations. Compared with submachine guns that typically used 9mm pistol ammunition, the M733 offered greater power and rifle-caliber performance, while still being much shorter and more CQB-friendly than a standard M16. As a result, the Colt M733 became popular with police and special forces users, including Delta Force and USMC Force Recon. The M733 also gained recognition through its appearances in films, most famously Black Hawk Down and Heat. Even today, many collectors and players still appreciate this retro AR-style carbine for its compact profile, old-school tactical look, and strong connection to classic special operations history.
